next_steps: Run /implement 628 to execute the plan. Before dispatching implementation, refresh task 628's file_scope in specs/state.json from the plan's 'Artifacts & Outputs' section: the plan re-sites the port from Semantics/Extension/{HybridState,PropQuant}.lean (research-era paths, predating the language-directory merge) to FormalSystem/HybridLanguage/, FormalSystem/QuantLanguage/ and FormalSystem/Semantics/HistoryMorphism.lean, and also touches scripts/, Tests/ and docs/ registration files.

memory_candidates.content: A research probe under specs/**/probes that was compiled with `lake env lean` can keep exiting 0 after the modules it imports are moved or renamed, because stale .olean files for the old module paths survive under .lake/build and `lake env lean` resolves imports from the olean search path, not from source. Before planning a port from a probe, check every `import` line against the source tree (ls the .lean path), re-type the statements against the live module paths, and type-check them afresh. Gate implementation phases on `lake build <target>` (which resolves imports from source), never on `lake env lean <file>` alone.
